title: Projective modules over local rings are free in arbitrary rank
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative local ring, meaning a commutative ring with a unique maximal ideal. Let $P$ be a projective $R$-module [def-weil-pbc-projective-module], with no finite-generation hypothesis. Then $P$ is free [def-weil-pbc-free-module]: there are a set $B$ (possibly empty or infinite) and an $R$-linear isomorphism $\bigoplus_{b\in B}R\cong P$.
